headline: Emmy Awards moving from broadcast TV to Prime Video
summary: The Emmy Awards will move to Amazon's Prime Video starting in 2027, with Amazon reportedly paying up to $25 million a year for exclusive global rights, and non-subscribers able to watch on the platform.
